title: Bound on a selected Fourier family
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $t$ be a positive rational number, and let $\varepsilon$ be a rational number with $0<\varepsilon\le 1/2$. If $J$ is a subset of $[n]$ whose cardinality is at most the coordinate cap determined by $t$ and $\varepsilon$, then the family of subsets of $J$ of size at most the corresponding degree has cardinality at most the corresponding family bound.
hypotheses_covered: $|J|$ is at most the coordinate cap determined by $t$ and $\varepsilon$
